photos.desc: Pelorovis antiquus, lithograph of skull by Ferrand del Imprimeur de Becquet, Paris, in book Bubalus antiquus (1893), plate I, part of series Carte de Géologie de l’Algérie - Paléontologie Monographies
Detail of a petroglyph depicting a Bubalus antiquus , eponymous of the Bubalus Period of Saharan rock art . Located at Tin Taghirt on the Tassili n’Ajjer in southern Algeria.
